import dis
import py_compile

def fib(n):
    if n <= 1: return n
    return fib(n-1) + fib(n-2)

# See CPython bytecode:
dis.dis(fib)
description: This Python function defines Fibonacci recursion and asks dis to show its bytecode.

steps.description: The imports provide bytecode disassembly and Python compilation support.
fib returns n for the base case and otherwise adds two recursive calls.
dis.dis displays the CPython bytecode for fib.
